about: Two formulas of petition, the first addressed to almighty God and the second to the almighty and merciful Lord. The first asks mercy, the forgiveness of sins and eternal life, the second pardon, absolution and remission of sins. This is not the sacramental formula Ego te absolvo.

seg.nr: With hands joined, the priest says the prayer for forgiveness.

seg.tr: May almighty God have mercy on you and, having forgiven your sins, bring you to eternal life.

seg.nr: The priest signs himself and says the second prayer.

seg.tr: May the almighty and merciful Lord grant us pardon, absolution and remission of our sins.
